title: Well-Log Reconstruction with Pre-trained Geological Knowledge: A Knowledge-Conditioned Large-Language-Model Generative Agent
abstract: arXiv:2611.19624v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Missing well-log intervals make subsurface reconstruction ill-posed. Existing numerical regression models lack geological prior knowledge to constrain ambiguous inverse mappings. We propose GeoLog-Agent, a knowledge-conditioned generative agent using pre-trained large language models (LLMs) as a source of geological priors. A universal Geo-Harness translates LLM stratigraphic reasoning into formation-anchored petrophysical trajectories, feature-wise linear modulation, and conditional adversarial constraints. On the Norwegian North Sea benchmark, GeoLog-Agent achieves a mean $R^2$ of 0.9307 and a peak $R^2$ of 0.9713. It exceeds the nine-baseline average $R^2$ of 0.8387 by 0.0920, with a 30.97% average RMSE reduction, and exceeds the strongest baseline by 0.0274--0.0498 in $R^2$, with 16.25%--24.05% lower RMSE. Ablations confirm the effectiveness and synergy of geological prior reasoning, multi-scale dilated generation, and conditional

translated_title: 基于预训练地质知识的测井曲线重建：一种知识条件化的大语言模型生成智能体
translated_abstract: 缺失的测井曲线区间使得地下重建成为一个病态问题。现有的数值回归模型缺乏地质先验知识来约束模糊的逆映射。我们提出了GeoLog-Agent，一种知识条件化的生成智能体，利用预训练大语言模型（LLM）作为地质先验知识的来源。一个通用的Geo-Harness将LLM的地层推理转化为地层锚定的岩石物理轨迹、特征级线性调制以及条件对抗约束。在挪威北海基准数据集上，GeoLog-Agent实现了平均R²为0.9307、峰值R²为0.9713的成果。相比九个基线模型的平均R²0.8387，它高出0.0920，平均RMSE降低了30.97%；相比最强基线模型，R²高出0.0274–0.0498，RMSE降低了16.25%–24.05%。消融实验证实了地质先验推理、多尺度膨胀生成和条件对抗约束的有效性与协同作用。
tldr: 该论文提出GeoLog-Agent，将预训练大语言模型作为地质先验知识来源，通过Geo-Harness把LLM的地层推理转化为生成约束条件，从而显著提升测井曲线重建的精度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GeoLog-Agent, which uses pre-trained LLMs as a source of geological priors and translates their stratigraphic reasoning into generation constraints via a Geo-Harness, substantially improving well-log reconstruction accuracy.
